newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks easier in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks easier in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks eased after gaining marginally at the opening on Friday.
The Dow industrials' record rally overnight was supportive, but sentiment remained somewhat bearish due to the absence of major investors, brokers said.
At 0011 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 26.60 points or 0.13 percent at 20,094.81. Its September futures fell 90 points to 20.080.
"New York stocks hit a record high, but the Tokyo market lacks the energy to follow that trend," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
